application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: Replacement of the house's existing concrete roof tiles with slates and relocation of front roof lights, alterations to the ground floor rear elevation and like-for-like replacement of timber windows on other parts of the house, together with refurbishment and increasing the height of the existing rear detached garage and conversion to a garden room and office.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (2160.A3.23 (Rev A)  Received:  09 August 2022;  2160-A3-25 (Rev A); 2160.A3.26 (Rev A); 2160-A3-27 (Rev A); 2160-A3-28 (Rev A); 2160-A3-29 (Rev A); 2160-A3-31 (Rev A)  Received:  13 July 2022;  2160.A3.02 (Rev B); 2160.A3.03 (Rev B); 2160.A3.04 (Rev B); 2160.A3.05 (Rev B); 2160.A3.06 (Rev B); 2160.A3.07; 2160.A3.08; 2160.A3.09 (Rev A); 2160.A3.10; 2160.A3.11; 2160.A3.12 (Rev A); 2160.A3.32; 2160.A3.22; 2160.A3.24; 2160.A3.27; 2160.A3.30  Received:  27 May 2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the alterations to the original house hereby approved shall match those used in the original house only.

Condition : 4 - The refurbished existing detached rear outbuilding, following its conversion to a garden home and office, hereby approved shall have grey fibreglass flat roofing and double glazed aluminium powder coated bifolding doors only.

Condition : 5 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the existing single storey rear extension and existing detached single storey rear outbuilding following the alterations to them hereby approved.

Condition : 6 - Prior to the development hereby permitted being occupied, the existing vehicular access to No. 44 Hamilton Road (via Westbury Place) shall be permanently closed and a standard kerb and footway be reinstated, so that it cannot be used for vehicular access to the site over the public footway.

Condition : 7 - The refurbished and converted detached single storey rear outbuilding hereby approved shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the house at No. 44 Hamilton Road described at the top of this decision letter and for no other purpose (for example, it may not be used as a self-contained dwelling or contain a bedroom, bathroom, kitchen or other primary residential accommodation, nor may it be used for business purposes other than as a 'home office' by residents of No 44).
